_comment: Fill these in once. They appear on every client workbook. Leave a field empty to hide it. logo_path is relative to this file (e.g. 'logo.png' placed in this assets folder).
checkin_instructions: Fill in the Daily Check-in each evening — it takes 2 minutes and rough numbers are fine.
Every Sunday, answer the yellow questions on the Weekly Check-in and message your coach when it's done.
Your coach replies in the grey columns (and, when useful, with a short video or voice note) within 48 hours.
New pain, illness, a new medicine or a doctor's advice? Message your coach straight away — don't wait for the weekly check-in.
